verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אִם־ עָרַ֣בְתָּ לְרֵעֶ֑ךָ תָּקַ֖עְתָּ כַּפֶּֽיךָ׃ לַזָּ֣ר
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’im- ‘ā·raḇ·tā lə·rê·‘e·ḵā tā·qa‘·tā kap·pe·ḵā laz·zār
verses.literal: My son if you have put up security for your neighbor if you have struck hands in pledge . . . with a stranger

verses.original: נוֹקַ֥שְׁתָּ בְאִמְרֵי־ פִ֑יךָ נִ֝לְכַּ֗דְתָּ בְּאִמְרֵי־ פִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nō·w·qaš·tā ḇə·’im·rê- p̄î·ḵā nil·kaḏ·tā bə·’im·rê- p̄î·ḵā
verses.literal: if you have been trapped by the words of your lips ensnared by the words of your mouth

verses.original: אֵפ֪וֹא׀ עֲשֵׂ֨ה זֹ֥את בְּנִ֡י וְֽהִנָּצֵ֗ל כִּ֘י בָ֤אתָ רֵעֶ֑ךָ בְכַף־ לֵ֥ךְ הִ֝תְרַפֵּ֗ס וּרְהַ֥ב רֵעֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·p̄ō·w ‘ă·śêh zōṯ bə·nî wə·hin·nā·ṣêl kî ḇā·ṯā rê·‘e·ḵā ḇə·ḵap̄- lêḵ hiṯ·rap·pês ū·rə·haḇ rê·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: then do this my son to free yourself for you have fallen into your neighbor’s hands Go humble yourself and press your plea with your neighbor

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן אַל־ שֵׁנָ֣ה לְעֵינֶ֑יךָ וּ֝תְנוּמָ֗ה לְעַפְעַפֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tit·tên ’al- šê·nāh lə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·ṯə·nū·māh lə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pe·ḵā
verses.literal: Allow no sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids

verses.original: הִ֭נָּצֵל כִּצְבִ֣י מִיָּ֑ד וּ֝כְצִפּ֗וֹר מִיַּ֥ד יָקֽוּשׁ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hin·nā·ṣêl kiṣ·ḇî mî·yāḏ ū·ḵə·ṣip·pō·wr mî·yaḏ yā·qūš
verses.literal: Free yourself like a gazelle from the hand [of the hunter] like a bird from the snare of the fowler

verses.original: לֵֽךְ־ אֶל־ נְמָלָ֥ה עָצֵ֑ל רְאֵ֖ה דְרָכֶ֣יהָ וַחֲכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ- ’el- nə·mā·lāh ‘ā·ṣêl rə·’êh ḏə·rā·ḵe·hā wa·ḥă·ḵām
verses.literal: Walk in the manner of . . . the ant O slacker observe its ways and become wise

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֵֽין־ לָ֥הּ קָצִ֗ין שֹׁטֵ֥ר וּמֹשֵֽׁל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ’ên- lāh qā·ṣîn šō·ṭêr ū·mō·šêl
verses.literal: - Without a commander without an overseer or ruler

verses.original: תָּכִ֣ין לַחְמָ֑הּ בַּקַּ֣יִץ אָגְרָ֥ה מַאֲכָלָֽהּ׃ בַ֝קָּצִ֗יר
verses.transliteration: tā·ḵîn laḥ·māh baq·qa·yiṣ ’ā·ḡə·rāh ma·’ă·ḵā·lāh ḇaq·qā·ṣîr
verses.literal: it prepares its provisions in summer it gathers its food at harvest

verses.original: מָתַ֖י עַד־ תִּשְׁכָּ֑ב עָצֵ֥ל׀ מָ֝תַ֗י תָּק֥וּם מִשְּׁנָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ṯay ‘aḏ- tiš·kāḇ ‘ā·ṣêl mā·ṯay tā·qūm miš·šə·nā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: How long will you lie there O slacker When will you get up from your sleep

verses.original: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט׀ חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: mə·‘aṭ šē·nôt̲ mə·‘aṭ tə·nū·mō·wṯ mə·‘aṭ ḥib·buq yā·ḏa·yim liš·kāḇ
verses.literal: A little sleep a little slumber a little folding of the hands to rest

verses.original: רֵאשֶׁ֑ךָ וּבָֽא־ כִמְהַלֵּ֥ךְ וּ֝מַחְסֹֽרְךָ֗ כְּאִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: rê·še·ḵā ū·ḇā- ḵim·hal·lêḵ ū·maḥ·sō·rə·ḵā kə·’îš mā·ḡên
verses.literal: and poverty will come upon you like a robber and need like a bandit . . .

verses.original: בְּ֭לִיַּעַל אָדָ֣ם אָ֑וֶן אִ֣ישׁ ה֝וֹלֵ֗ךְ עִקְּשׁ֥וּת פֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·lî·ya·‘al ’ā·ḏām ’ā·wen ’îš hō·w·lêḵ ‘iq·qə·šūṯ peh
verses.literal: A worthless person a wicked man walks with a perverse mouth

verses.original: קֹרֵ֣ץ בְּ֭עֵינָו מֹלֵ֣ל בְּרַגְלָ֑ו מֹ֝רֶ֗ה בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: qō·rêṣ bə·ʿē·nå̄w mō·lêl bə·raḡ·lå̄w mō·reh bə·’eṣ·bə·‘ō·ṯāw
verses.literal: winking his eyes speaking with his feet and pointing with his fingers

verses.original: תַּֽהְפֻּכ֨וֹת׀ בְּלִבּ֗וֹ חֹרֵ֣שׁ רָ֣ע בְּכָל־ עֵ֑ת יְשַׁלֵּֽחַ׃ מְדָנִים
verses.transliteration: tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ bə·lib·bōw ḥō·rêš rā‘ bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ yə·šal·lê·aḥ mə·ḏå̄·nīm
verses.literal: With deceit in his heart he devises evil he continually . . . sows discord

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֗ן אֵיד֑וֹ יָב֣וֹא פִּ֭תְאֹם פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְאֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ê·ḏōw yā·ḇō·w piṯ·’ōm pe·ṯa‘ yiš·šā·ḇêr wə·’ên mar·pê
verses.literal: Therefore . . . calamity will come upon him suddenly in an instant he will be shattered beyond recovery

verses.original: הֵ֭נָּה שֶׁשׁ־ יְהוָ֑ה שָׂנֵ֣א וְ֝שֶׁ֗בַע תּוֹעֲבוֹת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hên·nāh šeš- Yah·weh śā·nê wə·še·ḇa‘ tō·ʿă·ḇōṯ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: There are six [things that] the LORD hates seven that are detestable to Him

verses.original: רָ֭מוֹת עֵינַ֣יִם שָׁ֑קֶר לְשׁ֣וֹן וְ֝יָדַ֗יִם שֹׁפְכ֥וֹת נָקִֽי׃ דָּם־
verses.transliteration: rā·mō·wṯ ‘ê·na·yim šā·qer lə·šō·wn wə·yā·ḏa·yim šō·p̄ə·ḵō·wṯ nā·qî dām-
verses.literal: haughty eyes a lying tongue hands that shed innocent blood

verses.original: לֵ֗ב חֹ֭רֵשׁ אָ֑וֶן מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רַגְלַ֥יִם לָר֥וּץ מְ֝מַהֲר֗וֹת לָֽרָעָה׃
verses.transliteration: lêḇ ḥō·rêš ’ā·wen maḥ·šə·ḇō·wṯ raḡ·la·yim lā·rūṣ mə·ma·hă·rō·wṯ lå̄·rå̄·ʿå̄h
verses.literal: a heart that devises wicked schemes feet that run swiftly to evil

verses.original: שָׁ֑קֶר עֵ֣ד כְּ֭זָבִים יָפִ֣יחַ וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥חַ מְ֝דָנִ֗ים בֵּ֣ין אַחִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: šā·qer ‘êḏ kə·zā·ḇîm yā·p̄î·aḥ ū·mə·šal·lê·aḥ mə·ḏā·nîm bên ’a·ḥîm
verses.literal: a false witness who gives false testimony and one who stirs up discord among brothers

verses.original: בְּ֭נִי נְצֹ֣ר אָבִ֑יךָ מִצְוַ֣ת וְאַל־ תִּ֝טֹּ֗שׁ אִמֶּֽךָ׃ תּוֹרַ֥ת
verses.transliteration: bə·nî nə·ṣōr ’ā·ḇî·ḵā miṣ·waṯ wə·’al- tiṭ·ṭōš ’im·me·ḵā tō·w·raṯ
verses.literal: My son keep your father’s commandment and do not forsake your mother’s teaching

verses.original: קָשְׁרֵ֣ם תָמִ֑יד עַל־ לִבְּךָ֣ עָ֝נְדֵ֗ם עַל־ גַּרְגְּרֹתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qā·šə·rêm ṯā·mîḏ ‘al- lib·bə·ḵā ‘ā·nə·ḏêm ‘al- gar·gə·rō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Bind them always upon your heart tie them around your neck

verses.original: בְּהִתְהַלֶּכְךָ֨׀ תַּנְחֶ֬ה אֹתָ֗ךְ בְּֽ֭שָׁכְבְּךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר עָלֶ֑יךָ וַ֝הֲקִיצ֗וֹתָ הִ֣יא תְשִׂיחֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·hiṯ·hal·leḵ·ḵā tan·ḥeh ’ō·ṯāḵ bə·šā·ḵə·bə·ḵā tiš·mōr ‘ā·le·ḵā wa·hă·qî·ṣō·w·ṯā hî ṯə·śî·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: When you walk they will guide you when you lie down they will watch over you when you awake they will speak to you

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֭צְוָה נֵ֣ר וְת֣וֹרָה א֑וֹר תּוֹכְח֥וֹת מוּסָֽר׃ וְדֶ֥רֶךְ חַ֝יִּ֗ים
verses.transliteration: kî miṣ·wāh nêr wə·ṯō·w·rāh ’ō·wr tō·wḵ·ḥō·wṯ mū·sār wə·ḏe·reḵ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: For this commandment is a lamp this teaching [is] a light and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life

verses.original: לִ֭שְׁמָרְךָ רָ֑ע מֵאֵ֣שֶׁת מֵֽ֝חֶלְקַ֗ת לָשׁ֥וֹן נָכְרִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: liš·mā·rə·ḵā rā‘ mê·’ê·šeṯ mê·ḥel·qaṯ lā·šō·wn nā·ḵə·rî·yāh
verses.literal: to keep you from the evil woman from the smooth tongue of the adulteress

verses.original: אַל־ תַּחְמֹ֣ד בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְאַל־ יָ֭פְיָהּ תִּ֝קָּֽחֲךָ֗ בְּעַפְעַפֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- taḥ·mōḏ bil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā wə·’al- yā·p̄ə·yāh tiq·qā·ḥă·ḵā bə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pe·hā
verses.literal: Do not lust in your heart . . . for her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes

verses.original: כִּ֤י בְעַד־ אִשָּׁ֥ה זוֹנָ֗ה כִּכַּ֫ר לָ֥חֶם עַֽד־ וְאֵ֥שֶׁת אִ֑ישׁ תָצֽוּד׃פ יְקָרָ֣ה נֶ֖פֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: kî ḇə·‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh zō·w·nāh kik·kar lā·ḥem ‘aḏ- wə·’ê·šeṯ ’îš ṯā·ṣūḏ yə·qā·rāh ne·p̄eš
verses.literal: For the levy vvv of the prostitute is poverty . . . . . . and the adulteress . . . preys upon your very life

verses.original: אִ֓ישׁ הֲיַחְתֶּ֤ה בְּחֵיק֑וֹ אֵ֬שׁ וּ֝בְגָדָ֗יו לֹ֣א תִשָּׂרַֽפְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš hă·yaḥ·teh bə·ḥê·qōw ’êš ū·ḇə·ḡā·ḏāw lō ṯiś·śā·rap̄·nāh
verses.literal: Can a man embrace . . . fire and his clothes not be burned

verses.original: אִם־ אִ֭ישׁ יְהַלֵּ֣ךְ עַל־ הַגֶּחָלִ֑ים לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶֽינָה׃ וְ֝רַגְלָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’îš yə·hal·lêḵ ‘al- hag·ge·ḥā·lîm lō ṯik·kā·we·nāh wə·raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: Can a man walk on hot coals without scorching his feet

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן הַ֭בָּא אֶל־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ אֵ֣שֶׁת לֹ֥א כָּֽל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּֽהּ׃ יִ֝נָּקֶ֗ה
verses.transliteration: kên hab·bā ’el- rê·‘ê·hū ’ê·šeṯ lō kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bāh yin·nā·qeh
verses.literal: So is he who sleeps with . . . another man’s wife no one . . . who touches her will go unpunished

verses.original: לֹא־ יָב֣וּזוּ לַ֭גַּנָּב כִּ֣י יִגְנ֑וֹב לְמַלֵּ֥א נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ כִּ֣י יִרְעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·ḇū·zū lag·gan·nāḇ kî yiḡ·nō·wḇ lə·mal·lê nap̄·šōw kî yir·‘āḇ
verses.literal: [Men] do not despise the thief if he steals to satisfy his vvv hunger

verses.original: וְ֭נִמְצָא יְשַׁלֵּ֣ם שִׁבְעָתָ֑יִם אֶת־ יִתֵּֽן׃ כָּל־ ה֖וֹן בֵּית֣וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·nim·ṣā yə·šal·lêm šiḇ·‘ā·ṯā·yim ’eṯ- yit·tên kāl- hō·wn bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Yet if caught he must pay sevenfold - he must give up all the wealth of his house

verses.original: נֹאֵ֣ף אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲסַר־ לֵ֑ב ה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂנָּה׃ מַֽשְׁחִ֥ית נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: nō·’êp̄ ’iš·šāh ḥă·sar- lêḇ hū ya·‘ă·śen·nāh maš·ḥîṯ nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: He who commits adultery . . . lacks judgment whoever does so destroys himself

verses.original: נֶֽגַע־ וְקָל֥וֹן יִמְצָ֑א וְ֝חֶרְפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִמָּחֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ne·ḡa‘- wə·qā·lō·wn yim·ṣā wə·ḥer·pā·ṯōw lō ṯim·mā·ḥeh
verses.literal: Wounds and dishonor will befall him and his reproach will never be wiped away

verses.original: כִּֽי־ קִנְאָ֥ה חֲמַת־ גָּ֑בֶר וְלֹֽא־ יַ֝חְמ֗וֹל בְּי֣וֹם נָקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- qin·’āh ḥă·maṯ- gā·ḇer wə·lō- yaḥ·mō·wl bə·yō·wm nā·qām
verses.literal: For jealousy enrages a husband . . . and he will show no mercy in the day of vengeance

verses.original: לֹא־ יִ֭שָּׂא פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ כֹּ֑פֶר וְלֹֽא־ יֹ֝אבֶ֗ה כִּ֣י תַרְבֶּה־ שֹֽׁחַד׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō- yiś·śā pə·nê ḵāl kō·p̄er wə·lō- yō·ḇeh kî ṯar·beh- šō·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: He will not be appeased . . . by any ransom [or] persuaded . . . by lavish gifts
